provider_set_resolution.site_semantics: The 191 aggregate records represent WALKER SITE VISITS of ONE source AST location under the existing specialization semantics -- NOT 191 unique source locations. Mechanically verified: an ast walk of ServiceContainer.resolve (defined at core/container.py:87) contains EXACTLY ONE Call node whose callee text is 'registration.provider' -- 'registration.provider(cast(Resolver, self))' at core/container.py:116. The 191 records are distributed across 74 distinct site labels, all carrying that same callee text, because the walker re-visits that single site once per enclosing specialization. Condition 7 of the authorization ('exactly ONE aggregate CallRecord per site visit') is satisfied: one record per visit, never one per target.
